title: Great Quality
text: Great Quality. I bought one of these and was so impressed with the quality that I went back and ordered two more to replace so-so ones we had in the closet.  A great buy, especially for the price.

product_metadata.title: Utopia Bedding Quilted Fitted Mattress Pad (Twin XL) - Elastic Fitted Mattress Protector - Mattress Cover Stretches up to 16 Inches Deep - Machine Washable Mattress Topper
features: MATTRESS PAD - Twin XL size mattress pad measures 39 by 80 inches; The skirt fits to 16-inch deep mattress; for best results please protect the cover as it is NOT WATERPROOF or SPILL PROOF
DURABLE - Quilted mattress pad cover is durable and long lasting and is significant for keeping your mattress free of stains
SOFT AND COMFORTABLE - This super soft quilt with fiberfill has additional loft that provides extra comfortable sleep and protection; The elastic all around secures the pad into position
AN IDEAL CHOICE - This mattress pad is a perfect choice if you're considering a comfortable, soft, breathable and high quality mattress pad
CARE INSTRUCTIONS - The cover is machine washable and you can tumble dry on low; do not bleach; easy maintenance; natural drying
